subject: Post-call: SOC 2, retention & DPA - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2, retention & DPA - Acme Health

Alice / team - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have clear next steps and acceptance criteria on the security/compliance side. Please reply with any corrections.

Key pain points you called out:
- Upcoming SOC 2 scope for Q3 audit; you need to validate vendor controls and evidence for inference workloads.
- Audit log access: requirement to export raw audit logs and stream them to your SIEM for a 7-year retention window.
- Data residency & retention: patient PII retention rules and deletion workflows (records removal + KV cache eviction guarantees).
- DPA + contractual amendments: standard DPA with a few clauses around data processor sub-processing and breach notification timelines.
- Pen test evidence: required summary of most recent third-party pentest + remediation timeline.

Goals we discussed:
- SOC 2 Type II evidence for 2025 (controls, monitoring, incident response) to satisfy your security team.
- Mechanism to export audit logs (s3/CloudWatch/secure stream) and a retention plan that maps to your retention policy.
- Options: Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private (VPC/on-prem) evaluated for isolation and contractual terms.
- KMS/HSM integration for customer-managed keys and key rotation calendar.

What Redwood will provide next (action items):
1) Share SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and our most recent pen test summary - attaching to follow email.
2) Draft DPA (Redwood_DPA_v3) for your legal to review; highlight the sub-processing and breach notif sections.
3) Technical note on audit log formats, recommended retention pipeline, and example bucket lifecycle rules.
4) Propose a technical deep-dive (security + infra) next week to walk through architecture, log export, and KMS integration.

Proposed timeline:
- Today 2/18: I'll send the SOC2 report + DPA draft + pen test summary.
- 2/20-2/24: Technical deep-dive with your security engineer + our infra/ops (30-45m).
- 2/27: Target to capture any DPA redlines and confirm deployment option (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

If that looks right I'll send the attachments and calendar invite for the deep-dive.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

(attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf) (attachment: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf)

From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2, retention & DPA - Acme Health

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our security and procurement teams: 

1) SOC 2 evidence: we need the Type II report for 2025 and the list of in-scope systems/services. Please include the auditor name and the covered control set.
2) Pen test: redacted executive summary is OK, but we also need a statement of any high/critical findings and confirmation that they were remediated.
3) Audit logs: format (CSV/JSON), available fields (requester, timestamp, model, tokens, request_id), and whether we can set up a continuous stream to our S3 bucket with server-side encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS).
4) Retention: we have a legal requirement to retain logs for 7 years; will Redwood support lifecycle policies and scheduled export?
5) DPA: please send the DPA draft and flag the processor/sub-processor section; our counsel will redline.
6) Encryption: confirm encryption at rest and in transit, and whether customer-managed keys (BYOK) are supported in Dedicated/Private modes.

Can you also provide a ballpark cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted for the anticipated throughput we discussed (~10k requests/day, median latency target <200ms)? Procurement wants an estimate ahead of the technical call.

If you can send the documents today that would be ideal - we'll aim to get security and procurement onto the deep-dive next week.

Thanks,
Alice Turner
Security Program Manager | Acme Health
alice.turner@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, security@acmehealth.com, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2, retention & DPA - Acme Health

Alice - great, thanks for the list. Attached are the items you requested and a short FAQ addressing the log fields and KMS options. Summary below and next steps.

Attachments included:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted) - auditor: LumenAudits LLC; in-scope: inference platform, access control, change mgmt, incident response.
- pen_test_summary_redwood_2025.pdf - executive summary + high/critical findings (none outstanding; all remediation completed as of 2025-11-12).
- Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf - draft DPA with sub-processor appendix and breach notification timeline (30 days).
- audit_log_spec.md (also attached inline) - sample JSON/CSV schema and example lifecycle rule for S3 export.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Audit log fields: timestamp, request_id, model_id, route, internal_user_id (redacted on export if requested), token_count, response_status, region, infra_node_id. Full spec attached.
- Streaming/export: yes - we can export logs continuously to your S3 bucket with SSE-KMS. We support lifecycle rules and configurable retention; we can map to 7-year retention and provide a digest to confirm deletions.
- Encryption: TLS in transit; encryption at rest with customer-managed keys (BYOK) supported in Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted supports SSE-KMS with Redwood-managed keys; BYOK available on Dedicated/Private.
- Pen test: attached executive summary; no open high/critical findings. Full report available under NDA if required.
- Cost delta: rough estimate attached (Hosted vs Dedicated) for 10k req/day. Rishi will follow up with formal pricing and a Dedicated capacity proposal.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal technical deep-dive: propose Mon 2/23 or Tue 2/24 (30-45m). Neha (ops/security) and Rishi (solutions) will lead from Redwood. Please share your security engineer's availability.
2) Legal: we'll accept redlines on Redwood_DPA_v3; I'll track via DocuSign for signature once agreed.
3) If you need the full pen test under NDA, we can route that to your counsel.

I'll send calendar invites once we confirm availability. Thanks again - let us know any other evidence you need ahead of the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, pen_test_summary_redwood_2025.pdf, Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf, audit_log_spec.md
